comparisons.peer_topic: Diversity, Belonging and Inclusion (DB&I) Philosophy and Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD believes that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique voices strengthens the company. This approach includes fostering an environment where employees share diverse opinions and perspectives.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose human capital strategies focused on employee engagement, culture, and belonging, though they emphasize different mechanisms. NVDA highlights enhancing support during specific crises like war or economic volatility to retain talent, whereas AMD focuses on the foundational philosophy of building a diverse talent pipeline and a culture of respect and belonging to strengthen the company.

sentences.text: Our support is enhanced during times of crisis, such as war or economic volatility, to take care of our existing team of world-class talent and their families.
We believe that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique and underrepresented voices makes our company stronger.
